This folder contains LibRaw compiled to WebAssembly by the libraw-wasm project
(https://www.npmjs.com/package/libraw-wasm, ISC license), shipped unmodified as
separate files (libraw.js, libraw.wasm, worker.js, index.js). You may replace
these files with your own build of LibRaw. Source: https://github.com/LibRaw/LibRaw
